Select approved drugs with the indication 'leukemia'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading for 'leukemia'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id aliased as indication_curie, mesh_heading aliased as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
